How Redevelopment Works

From Old to New,
Step by Step

01—Assess

We evaluate your existing structure, land size, and rebuilding potential.

02—Agree

We agree on the sharing ratio and terms together, in plain language – no fine print surprises.

03—Design & Approve

Our architects design the new structure and secure every necessary approval.

04—Demolish & Build

We clear the old structure and build to the same quality standards as every Indu Housing project.

05—Handover

You receive your share of the newly built space, ready to occupy or sell.
